method: All 511 original unresolved entries received FEC candidate/committee matching and a Wikipedia/Commons discovery pass. Named person pages were reviewed individually; 447 other entries received individual Commons searches. Forty-one additional priority/context searches completed. The optional grouped state expansion had 88 transport 403 errors and is not counted as a completed search; those errors are preserved. No facial recognition or speculative person matching.
